module: Flowgraph node "Custom Button TEST" (category once_instant, description "TEST"): test node that displays a "Click me!" button via the UI hook 'CustomFGButtons'. Output "btn_1" (flow) set to true when the button is clicked. Do not use in production.
notes: Test node: openDialogue/closeDialogue reference self.open but workOnce does not open via openDialogue; self.open stays false, so the dialogue is not closed on stop.

_executionStopped.desc: Closes the dialogue if it is open.

buttonPushed.desc: Sets the output pin matching the clicked button to true, the others to false.

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

closeDialogue.desc: Sends an empty list to 'CustomFGButtons' (hides the buttons).

getCmd.desc: Builds the Lua command that calls buttonPushed(action) back on this node.

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

onNodeReset.desc: Closes the dialogue if it is open.

openDialogue.desc: Sends the "Click me!" button to the UI and sets done = true.

workOnce.desc: Sends the "Click me!" button to the UI (guihooks 'CustomFGButtons').
